question: Hammer, anvil, stirrup are all parts of a human's _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ear**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vibrations inside the ear **are amplified by the** three bones**, namely the hammer, anvil and stirrup in the middle ear.
 
• These three bones are known as the **ossicles**.
 
• **Malleus, incus, and stapes** are the real names of these bones respectively.
 
• Ear in the human body performs two functions, namely: Hearing and maintaining the balance of the body.
